title: W11187658 — Service mode entry
description: Enter service mode to cycle water valve, wash pump/heater, dispenser, and drain pump (§2-3).

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 18" & 24" ADA Built-In Dishwasher Service Manual

steps.title: Power off, door open
steps.body: Turn dishwasher off so no LEDs are lit. Disconnect power with the door open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Turn the dishwasher off and make sure no LED's are lit. Disconnect power to the dishwasher.

steps.title: Service mode entry
steps.body: Reapply power with door open. Within 60 seconds, press and hold the model-specific button pair (24" front: On/Off + Start/Pause; 18" front: Cycles + Start/Cancel; 24" top: Heavy + Start). Close door — service mode cycles valve, wash/heater, dispenser, drain, then board type code.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reapply power with the door open and quickly press and hold both buttons within 60 seconds from connecting power.
